exams.name: Division examination for certificate of qualification
exams.notes: Examination covers general business knowledge, rules and regulations of the division, and the Construction Industries Licensing Act; GB, MM, EE and other designated classifications also require a technical knowledge test.
exams.quote: no certificate of qualification shall be issued to an individual desiring to be a qualifying party until he has passed with a satisfactory score an examination approved and adopted by the division

exams.name: Journeyman plumber examination for certificate of competence
exams.notes: Applicant must have two years of experience in the trade or equivalent, or have completed an approved vocational course.
exams.quote: An applicant for a certificate of competence shall be required to take an examination approved and adopted by the division as to his knowledge of the orders and rules governing the occupation or trade for which a certificate is sought, and as to his technical knowledge and ability pertaining to his particular trade.

interval_years.quote: Contractor's licenses shall expire two years after the issuance date or as determined by the division, but in no instance less than one year, and shall be renewable upon application to the division and payment of the prescribed renewal fee

required.quote: Licensees and journeyman certificate holders may be required to complete and submit proof of continuing education as a prerequisite for renewal of a license. When required by rule adopted by the division, an applicant for a license renewal must submit with the application for license renewal proof of eight hours of instruction in code change and eight hours of instruction in other industry-related and division-approved subjects.

qualifier_replacement_notice_days.quote: the licensee and the qualifying party shall notify the division within thirty days of that termination in relationship

qualifier_replacement_grace_period_days.quote: the license shall be suspended for one hundred twenty days from the date of the termination of employment or business relationship and then canceled unless another individual who is a properly certified qualifying party is approved as the qualifying party for the licensee.

minor_plumbing_repair_exemption.quote: No permit shall be required for the performance of any of the following classes of work: minor repairs, replacement of lamps, the connection of portable electrical equipment to suitable receptacles which are permanently installed, minor repairs or replacement of or to faucets, taps or jets or connection of portable equipment to suitable connections or inlets which have been permanently installed

small_project_dollar_threshold.quote: an individual who works on one undertaking or project at a time that, in the aggregate or singly, does not exceed seven thousand two hundred dollars ($7,200) compensation a year, the work being casual, minor or inconsequential, such as handyman repairs; provided that this exemption shall not apply to any undertaking or project pertaining to the installation, connection or repair of electrical wiring, plumbing or gas fitting
